question.text: If the investor is an employee or director of the Category III AIF or its Manager, the minimum investment value is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.2, employees/directors of Cat III AIF/Manager have minimum investment of Rs. 25 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 1 crore applies to non-employee investors. Cross-Exam Context: Same Rs. 25 lakh employee threshold used in the PIT minimum (Ch 5). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Employees benefiting from this carve-out must be entered in the PPM disclosure.
